title: Replaying the chant recording raises the temperature and brings an orb
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Replaying the chant recording raises the temperature and brings an orb, about 2020s at Homestead 2, Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Temperature elevated and in that exercise an orb of light appeared in the homestead

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for reports of strange events, told podcast host Jesse Michels about something that happened there in the 2020s. He says that when his team played back a recording of chanting at a spot called Homestead 2, the temperature went up and a ball of light appeared inside the homestead. To him, it suggests something at the ranch responds to sound.
